bounded_growth.criterion: RSS: the last quarter is at most 1.05 times the third quarter (plateau) AND the first-to-last rise extrapolated to one million episodes stays under 1024 MiB (magnitude). Ledger: bytes per episode in the last quarter is at most 1.05 times the first quarter.

invariants_checked: every escalation carries a written summary

LATENCY.semantics: response annotated with injected_latency_ms, path continues

WRONG_TOOL.semantics: mis-selected call refused and traced, no ungated write

APPROVER_UNREACHABLE.semantics: card expired to EXPIRED_DENIED, deny-by-default, written summary

AGENT_MISROUTE.semantics: mis-selected call refused and traced, no ungated write

GUARDRAIL_BYPASS.semantics: bypass can only annotate; the gate runs first and a fabricated token is still refused

CORRUPTION.semantics: sentinel caught by the range check before any approval card

CONTEXT_OVERFLOW.semantics: oversized context refused at the LLM boundary, escalate

A2A_TIMEOUT.semantics: retryable timeout at the MCP client boundary; the read-class tool degrades the system, the write is refused server-side, episode escalates

TOOL_FAILURE.semantics: structured fault error, no write, escalation with a written summary
